```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
```

### A

```{r returns}
a <- read.table("../../data/statc183c283_5stocks.txt", header = TRUE)
a <- a[nrow(a):1, ]
prices <- as.matrix(a[, -1])
colnames(prices) <- c("Exxon-Mobil", "General Motors", "Hewlett-Packard",
                      "McDonalds", "Boeing")
r <- prices[-1, ] / prices[-nrow(prices), ] - 1
```

### B

```{r statistics}
means <- colMeans(r)
covmat <- cov(r)
kable(data.frame(Stock = names(means), Mean = means),
      digits = 6, row.names = FALSE)
kable(covmat, digits = 6)
```

### C

```{r two-stock-minimum}
stocks2 <- c("Exxon-Mobil", "Boeing")
mu2 <- means[stocks2]
Sigma2 <- covmat[stocks2, stocks2]
z2 <- solve(Sigma2, rep(1, 2))
w_min2 <- z2 / sum(z2)
mean_min2 <- sum(w_min2 * mu2)
sd_min2 <- sqrt(drop(t(w_min2) %*% Sigma2 %*% w_min2))
kable(data.frame(Stock = stocks2, Weight = w_min2),
      digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
kable(data.frame(Mean = mean_min2, SD = sd_min2), digits = 6)
```

### D

```{r two-stock-curve}
x1 <- seq(-2, 3, length.out = 1000)
x2 <- 1 - x1
curve2 <- data.frame(
  Mean = x1 * mu2[1] + x2 * mu2[2],
  SD = sqrt(x1^2 * Sigma2[1, 1] + x2^2 * Sigma2[2, 2] +
              2 * x1 * x2 * Sigma2[1, 2])
)
curve2$Branch <- ifelse(curve2$Mean >= mean_min2,
                        "Efficient", "Inefficient")
ggplot(curve2, aes(x = 100 * SD, y = 100 * Mean)) +
  geom_path(aes(linetype = Branch)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Efficient = "solid",
                                  Inefficient = "dashed")) +
  annotate("point", x = 100 * sd_min2, y = 100 * mean_min2,
           shape = 17, size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 100 * sd_min2, y = 100 * mean_min2,
           label = "Minimum risk", hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Monthly standard deviation (%)",
       y = "Mean monthly return (%)", linetype = "Frontier") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### E

```{r three-stock-cloud}
stocks3 <- c("Exxon-Mobil", "McDonalds", "Boeing")
mu3 <- means[stocks3]
Sigma3 <- covmat[stocks3, stocks3]
combinations <- read.table("../../data/statc183c283_abc.txt", header = TRUE)
W <- t(as.matrix(combinations))
cloud <- data.frame(
  Mean = drop(t(mu3) %*% W),
  SD = sqrt(colSums(W * (Sigma3 %*% W)))
)
p_e <- ggplot(cloud, aes(x = 100 * SD, y = 100 * Mean)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(x = "Monthly standard deviation (%)",
       y = "Mean monthly return (%)") +
  theme_minimal()
p_e
```

### F

```{r tangency}
Rf <- 0.001
excess <- mu3 - Rf
z <- solve(Sigma3, excess)
w_G <- z / sum(z)
mean_G <- sum(w_G * mu3)
var_G <- drop(t(w_G) %*% Sigma3 %*% w_G)
sd_G <- sqrt(var_G)
kable(data.frame(Stock = stocks3, Weight = w_G),
      digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
kable(data.frame(Mean = mean_G, SD = sd_G), digits = 6)

p_f <- p_e +
  geom_abline(intercept = 100 * Rf,
              slope = (mean_G - Rf) / sd_G, color = "red") +
  annotate("point", x = 100 * sd_G, y = 100 * mean_G,
           color = "red", size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 100 * sd_G, y = 100 * mean_G,
           label = "G", hjust = -0.5, vjust = -0.5, size = 3)
p_f
```

### G

```{r capital-allocation}
E <- 0.6 * mean_G + 0.4 * Rf
sd_mix <- 0.6 * sd_G
kable(data.frame(Mean = E, SD = sd_mix), digits = 6)
p_f +
  annotate("point", x = 100 * sd_mix, y = 100 * E,
           color = "blue", shape = 17, size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 100 * sd_mix, y = 100 * E,
           label = "60% G", hjust = 1.15, vjust = -0.7, size = 3)
```

### H

```{r risky-weights}
x <- (E - Rf) * z / sum(excess * z)
kable(data.frame(Stock = stocks3, Weight = x),
      digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
```

These are the weights of the three risky stocks in the combined portfolio:
\(x = 0.6w_G\). They sum to 0.6; the remaining 0.4 is invested in the risk-free asset.

### I.1

```{r two-tangent-portfolios}
Rf1 <- 0.001
Rf2 <- 0.002
w_A <- w_G
z_B <- solve(Sigma3, mu3 - Rf2)
w_B <- z_B / sum(z_B)
mean_A <- mean_G
var_A <- var_G
mean_B <- sum(w_B * mu3)
var_B <- drop(t(w_B) %*% Sigma3 %*% w_B)
kable(data.frame(Stock = stocks3, A = w_A, B = w_B),
      digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
kable(data.frame(Portfolio = c("A", "B"),
                 Mean = c(mean_A, mean_B),
                 SD = sqrt(c(var_A, var_B))),
      digits = 6, row.names = FALSE)
```

### I.2

```{r portfolio-covariance}
cov_AB <- drop(t(w_A) %*% Sigma3 %*% w_B)
kable(data.frame(Covariance = cov_AB), digits = 6)
```

### I.3

```{r two-portfolio-frontier}
alpha_min <- (var_B - cov_AB) / (var_A + var_B - 2 * cov_AB)
mean_min3 <- alpha_min * mean_A + (1 - alpha_min) * mean_B
target_means <- seq(mean_min3, max(cloud$Mean), length.out = 1000)
alpha <- (target_means - mean_B) / (mean_A - mean_B)
frontier3 <- data.frame(
  Mean = alpha * mean_A + (1 - alpha) * mean_B,
  SD = sqrt(alpha^2 * var_A + (1 - alpha)^2 * var_B +
              2 * alpha * (1 - alpha) * cov_AB)
)
p_e + geom_path(data = frontier3, color = "blue", linewidth = 0.8)
```

### I.4

```{r three-stock-minimum}
z_min3 <- solve(Sigma3, rep(1, 3))
w_min3 <- z_min3 / sum(z_min3)
mean_min3 <- sum(w_min3 * mu3)
sd_min3 <- sqrt(drop(t(w_min3) %*% Sigma3 %*% w_min3))
```
